name: life-agent
description: Turn short natural-language outcomes into coordinated real-world actions across the host's available tools and connected services.

interface.shortDescription: Ask for the outcome. Life Agent handles the steps.
interface.longDescription: Life Agent interprets an outcome, discovers the capabilities already available in the host, executes as far as permissions allow, verifies the result, and handles the follow-up work that result creates.
defaultPrompt: Handle everything I need to do before my trip next week.
Move dinner with Mike to Friday and tell him.
Invoice Acme for the website and track the follow-up.
